message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

You wrote that this is your price and to ask if anything is unclear. One thing is: how it fits the offers we hold for the HX pump shaft.

We want a shaft supplier whose shop stays busy with us, and we say plainly that the award goes to the best package. On the price:

Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

On new business:

Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH looks for new customers (news:20260309-03).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 27.97; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.12; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. Its unit price is set against the competing offers above, and it gives your shop a steady part to plan with. Option B is an alternative if you prefer another payment term.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
